summary: Ansible prefixes variables holding bytes with b_ so text and bytes aren't mixed accidentally; text isn't prefixed since bytes appear only at borders.
questions: What does the b_ prefix on variable names mean in Ansible code?

answer_card.title: Prefix byte variables with b_
answer_card.answer_md:
Variables holding bytes get a `b_` prefix:
```python
filename = u'/var/tmp/café.txt'
b_filename = to_bytes(filename)
```
Text isn't prefixed because bytes only appear at borders.
